lines: If you own knee-high boots, you need this dress this winter.
Chunky cable knit, a mock neck, and a ribbed waist that keeps it fitted.
The front slit lets you actually walk in it, and the midi length looks so good over boots.
It comes in seven colors. Tap the link to see them.

clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 15 seconds, four quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person) with long brunette hair, friendly and confident, speaking English directly to the camera at a brisk, natural pace with no pauses between lines. In every shot she wears the exact caramel-brown cable-knit midi sweater dress from the reference images: mock neck, ribbed waistband, long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, vertical cable-knit pattern down the skirt with a diagonal wrap seam, fitted through the hip, midi length, and a front slit. Keep its color, knit pattern, neckline, waistband and slit identical to the references. She wears plain black knee-high leather boots with a low heel; the dress hem overlaps the boot tops.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): already wearing the dress and boots, she walks toward the camera from the mirror and says: "If you own knee-high boots, you need this dress this winter."
Shot 2 (3-7 s): detail close-ups: her hand runs over the chunky cable knit, then the mock neck, then the ribbed waist, while she says: "Chunky cable knit, a mock neck, and a ribbed waist that keeps it fitted."
Shot 3 (7-11 s): full-length shot; she steps toward the camera so the front slit opens over the boots, then turns once, saying: "The front slit lets you actually walk in it, and the midi length looks so good over boots."
Shot 4 (11-15 s): smiling close-up as she glances down at the dress and says: "It comes in seven colors. Tap the link to see them."
Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no brand names on any item.

qa.result: visual pass; speech pass pending owner listen (midi vs mini)

Color, plain bodice, cable skirt with diagonal wrap seam, mock neck, ribbed waist, slit and midi hem over the boot tops all match. No on-screen text, no logos. Transcript (faster-whisper): all four lines spoken in order; whisper heard knee-all and mini-length, likely mishearings of knee-high and midi length: owner to listen.
